The second item is the more interesting of the two and the reason this link is drawn at all: a low-frequency coding variant that raises the risk of vitamin D insufficiency also raises the odds of this disease, which is a genetic-instrument argument rather than another observational association. Both items stop at disease risk.

Graded above the vitamin D link into this same node, on evidence rather than on preference: this exposure has a quantified hazard, is described by its source as the strongest known risk factor for the disease, and is argued elsewhere to be necessary though not sufficient. The intermediates are nonetheless unknown, because no cited sentence follows the virus to myelin-reactive T cells; the route from infection to this node is exactly what the field is still arguing about.
